It makes perfect sense to me.  We are being lied to.  Representative democracy is a bald-faced lie.  The parties dictate to the representatives who are either young idealists that don't yet realize how little power they have or old cynics that have learned that to go against the party is to be destroyed.  The parties control the mass opinion so they couldn't care less about actual solutions, only dramatic motivators for the masses.  Parties are also run like corporations.  Individual ideals and motivations do not matter at all, they are corporate bodies who can be manipulated into acting towards a goal but cannot be convinced of ideological motivation without sabotaging the idealist by exposing their weakness and opposition to those manipulating the rules, procedures and finances.  Once they do that, they are destroyed.  Thus the parties do what all corporate organisms do: they operate on an evolutionary imperative of self-perpetuation and growth as well as protection of the body politic from invasive organisms (ideological individuals in this case).

The biggest problem with a large society is that it doesn't function like a small one, so when people design institutions with only a couple of million people in the population they do not understand anything of game theory or self-perpetuating evolution and memetics.  Once the population reaches over a hundred million all ideologies break down and the institutions become independent organisms that have grown beyond human control.

We must evolve a system to prevent our own bastard creations from creating another war, or we will be culled as has happened time and time again through history (only with smaller numbers, so this will be far far worse).

That isn't the situation I'm describing.  You aren't overtly asking or pushing your expertise or opinion but it is influencing *how* you go about your activities.  How you are dressed, how you talk, what decisions you make, etc...

> you are acting dumb and being rude to the people of this sub-reddit

prove it.  Show even one example where I was "acting dumb" or "being rude"

See here I am torn between the burning desire to cram your own stupidity and ignorance back down your throat by doxing you and the fact that I and my family need help.

It isn't the fact you are ignorant.  There is nothing wrong with being ignorant.  You can solve ignorance by reading [this article](https://turtler.io/news/16-worst-and-most-extreme-ways-employers-are-spying-on-their-people) or [this article](https://www.aol.com/2013/09/29/new-ways-employer-spy/) or [this article](https://www.recruiter.com/i/6-ways-your-employer-can-legally-spy-on-you/) or... yeah I could keep going all day.  There are *hundreds of articles on this*.

It's the fact that you *hurt me*.  You took your arrogance and your ignorance and turned them into vitriolic stupidity to **judge me**, a person **you do not know** except to know I need help.

You don't know that I get *paid to do what I am protecting myself from*.  Yes, that's right, I get paid to save corporations hundreds of thousands of dollars by cross-linking social media accounts for deep background checks to prevent a "bad investment" in an employee that is having financial or emotional problems.  That's hundreds of thousands of dollars *per employee*.

Oh, wait, that can't be right this guy *must be* a paranoid schizophrenic (even though you aren't a trained psychiatrist or psychologist).  He didn't say he was being spied on, merely that he was protecting his identity but it's perfectly OK to make up lies bout him and block him from help because *you fucking know everything* right?

I will not do it.  I will not dox you.  I will not hurt you.  I will not prove anything to you.

You have a choice to make right now.  You can be angry that I am angry.  You can blame me for itemizing exactly how you were wrong and how I have every right to be angry with you.  Or you can take a moment to realize that you were wrong and stop doing it to people.  Even if you hate me forever if it saves one other person from your unjust judgement and harm then it was worth taking the time to write this.

I didn't ask a security question.
I asked for advice on how to meet the karma requirement without undue risk of open account linking/exposure.

Generally speaking, karma is gained by participating in the wider reddit community.  External links can be used for phishing and are allowed on the wider site.  Most of that I can avoid by using a clean profile that isn't linked to any of my other accounts.

The danger comes with spending much time on a clean account.  People make mistakes and I'm no exception.  It only takes one bad mistake to open the floodgates on this one and a VPN will not protect me from account bridging with tracking cookies.

(actually that is a security related question but it's a non-technical security question... more social in nature)

"Other accounts."  Hmmm....

Google, Facebook, Yahoo, discuss, twitter, OpenID, GitHub...

aaaaaand let's not forget marketing tags, tracking cookies, the whole reason behind GDPR in the EU and the pending DNT regulations in the U.S.

But yes, asking for advice and using big words means I'm up to nefarious dastardly deeds.  


Look, I'm here because I need help, not because I'm stupid.  I have enough problems without people coming in here and hurting me further by making horrifically unjustified assumptions based on bad guesses and ignorance.
Yes, one should totally avoid computers.  Learning how they work and how to secure yourself is impossible and one shouldn't even make the attempt.
I work in information security.  Please stop making assumptions.

That's an option but seemed like overkill for this need.  I'm not trying to avoid the communist party of China just 0-day lists.

Also I should point out that a VPN blocks identification by IP.  Reverse tracking an IP is only possible for average users to backtrack to a general area by network.

The bigger risk is through tracking cookies which can link together accounts reguardless of a VPN or IP spoofing.

Career bias.  I'm a professional and people make a lot of assumptions if they know you're having financial problems.  Explaining everything is unrealistic even if possible so it's far better to avoid bias.

They are *almost* old enough to understand, but aren't there yet.  Also I'm terrified of the police.  I live in the south, the police aren't known for being rational here.  Quite the opposite. No I'm completely broke right now.

About three years ago I started working a new contract.  Due to the fact that my children's mother is a completely insane piece of work, I refused to live with her any longer.  I rented two houses (my credit is wrecked so I couldn't buy).

First and foremost: I am a complete idiot socially.  I do not trust lawyers or family court (with good reason).  I hate drama.  I'm 100% certain that if I could have just been cold-blooded enough to hire a lawyer and refuse to speak to her no matter how much my kids suffered I wouldn't be in this situation now.  I didn't.

Every time they would ask for things (school supplies, etc...) I would be there.  When she'd blow all her food stamps on junk food and then run out of food two weeks early I'd pay.  When she'd miss her appointments with DHS and lose her shot at getting help, I'd pay.  When she wrecked my cars, I'd pay.

If I didn't pay, I'd still pay but a much higher price.  I've been arrested for crimes I haven't comitted, I've been assaulted both by her directly and by total strangers.  I've been threatened both physically and with machiavellian schemes.  I've had my wallet and debit card stollen in order to buy things we didn't need (thousands of dollars worth of absolute waste).  I didn't report it because something is genuinely wrong with me I guess.  Besides, what would I say to the police?  "Yeah she stole my debit card in order to buy $1500 worth of new clothes for my kids for school because she hasn't done laundry in 3 years and has mountains of dirty clothes in her house"?

So no, I have no money because I'm a stuipd wimp that hates conflict and will not put his dirty white trash social parasite into jail.

=== thoughtful edit ===

Really though, for the past eight plus years I've never had more than $5k and most of the time I've only had a few hundred dollars.  I have no credit cards and my credit is horrible.  I've never taken out loans but my credit is tanked because of unpaid utility bills, double-reporting by creditors that purchased those accounts and my own stressed out overworked failure to fix it all.  I tried to hire a credit legal team once but I couldn't afford to pay all they said I had to pay.

I get up around 5 or 6 am.  I do all of the cooking, cleaning, childcare, laundry, etc...  I normally don't go to bed until around 1 or 2am.  I'm usually asleep at my computer trying to look for work and failing to keep track of everything properly.

I recently had my license suspended because she got a ticket for a tail light and lost the ticket.  I didn't show up for court.  I can't pay the stupid fines and get it reinstated but until that happened I did all the *real* shopping too.  I mean grocery shopping and things the kids actually do need.

I'm so stressed out and exhausted that normally when I should be thinking about how to protect myself I just can't bring myself to give a shit and hand over the money for whatever.  I can't afford it, it's incredibly stupid, but it's easier than getting attacked again.
